title: medicago × varia f. ambigua
intro: Medicago × varia f. ambigua, commonly known as a perennial legume, is a hybrid species of the Medicago genus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Medicago × varia f. ambigua include its use as a cardiotonic, diuretic, and expectorant, making it a potential treatment for cardiovascular diseases, kidney issues, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
